# Deliver a useful result promptly

Read `.verythinker/guides/efficiency.md` when installed; in the VeryThinker source repository read `resources/guides/efficiency.md`.

1. Answer conversation and read-only requests directly. Every engineering change, including small code, documentation, configuration, and skill edits, follows a managed V-model increment and the project's ASPICE-oriented process. Resume matching existing work; use authorized managed intake for new work.
2. Before implementation record measurable requirements/acceptance criteria, baseline, applicable design, and planned checks/expected outcomes; obtain required design/check reviews and pass design-ready. Maintain Requirement <-> Design <-> Implementation <-> Check <-> Evidence <-> Review traceability. Keep records concise; document reviewed non-applicability decisions.
3. Produce a concrete artifact and actual verification evidence; obtain independent review in a separate non-implementing invocation for every engineering change. Preserve ready, design-ready, verified, and accepted gates. Target first reviewable output within 300 seconds. Pending checks/review mean a draft checkpoint with explicit pending gates, never accepted completion.
4. Read relevant skill/reference sections on demand. Return concise findings with exact failure and source/evidence locators.
5. Confirm each role's native tools expose its assigned capabilities. Skills cannot override client permissions. Missing managed configuration, core operations, evidence, or an independent reviewer leaves a draft/non-accepted checkpoint with the exact pending gate. Use a scope, plan, or patch candidate until required ready/design-ready gates pass; preserve scope and resume when available.
6. Update project docs and complete configured archive/contribution steps with separate status. Report measured timings only when recorded.
